comments.author: INKU
comments.body_html:
Okay, so forgive me for the dumb comment - so is the durability change just a numerical one or does it actually impact stopping power?

So, for example, if I get hit once in the head with a low caliber round- my helmet will have no more durability and be subject to a follow up headshot, if I understand the description correctly?

comments.author: penguingreentea
comments.body_html:
the durability number impacts stopping power - basically, if your helmet has 50 durability, then all of that durability (besides the 1/1 plates) will cover your entire head until the durability is zeroed.

that example you provided applies only for enemy bots by default, so if you shoot them in the face/head/neck/wherever with something like a pistol round, then they might tank one or two before their helmet’s zeroed out, and then they are subject to essentially death by headshot

comments.author: swafromsteam
comments.body_html: Do the helmets also cover the face? Or is it just the face shields?

comments.author: penguingreentea
comments.body_html: helmets and face shields both cover the entire head, including the face

comments.author: swafromsteam
comments.body_html: Would there be a way to make it so the helmets only cover all head areas (including neck & excluding face) But have faceshields cover only the face?

comments.author: penguingreentea
comments.body_html:
you’ll have to change it yourself, but the code is pretty straightforward. in mod.ts, see the below:

for (const helmet of helmets) { // You will have to remove headcommon and eyes and jaw from this following block helmet._props.armorColliders = [ “HeadCommon”, “ParietalHead”, “BackHead”, “Ears”, “Eyes”, “Jaw”, “NeckFront”, “NeckBack” ];If you want to keep the armor buff to face shields so that get +2 to armor class, then change the below:

//you can remove the entire following block to keep face shields default to protecting only HeadCommon, Eyes, and Jaw visor._props.armorColliders = [ “HeadCommon”, “ParietalHead”, “BackHead”, “Ears”, “Eyes”, “Jaw”, “NeckFront”, “NeckBack” ];If you don’t want face shields to receive ANY buffs, then there’s a config option where you can disable face shields from being modified by this mod.

ideally all of this should work, but you’ll have to test it

comments.author: swafromsteam
comments.body_html:
I’ve been using the mod extensively and have a few things to say.

Firstly, helmets might be a little too “good”, I’ve found myself tanking bullets of M995, I don’t think I’m ricocheting them since I don’t get concussed. I am using a class 4 helmet (TC-800 to be specific). I honestly quite like being able to tank a high pen bullet but I never get the concussion effect when tanking/ricocheting a bullet which would be nice, maybe theres a way to tweak the mod to re-enable that?

Lastly, I’ve seen AI tanking 3-4 buckshot shells, of course I know about the durability and how killing somebody with low penetration bullets needs the helmet to be zero’d, but would there be a way to give buckshot more power? Shotguns in my experience are only really effective when using flechette or APs.
Anyways, you’ve made a great mod and I really enjoy it.
